rows.grounds: noun from tiras-kṛ; nominative singular feminine
compound tapana (sun) + locana (eye); accusative plural masculine

items.question: What is the consequence of defeating the sun-eyed demons?
items.inference: The verse states that after defeating the sun-eyed demons, the gods' rejoicing follows.
uncertainties: Exact referent of tiraskṛti is unclear
Whether tapana-locana is a proper epithet or descriptive compound
items.plain_english: Thus, having defeated the sun-eyed demons.
